xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5016: Overdeck Anywhere telemetry: PostHog for the phone apps, Anywhere desktop events and hosted services

plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere telemetry: PostHog for the phone apps, Anywhere desktop events and hosted services
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Overdeck Anywhere sends no telemetry: the typed PostHog schema (packages/contracts/src/telemetry.ts, docs/TELEMETRY.md) has no event for machine linking, phone pairing, secure-channel routes or relay use, so the maintainers cannot see adoption, link-method choice, relay fallback rate or real failure classes. The hosted Workers' stance on telemetry is undecided and undocumented.
narratives.Proposal: Add seven closed-enum events (machine_link_started/approved/failed, phone_paired, phone_removed, anywhere_channel_opened, relay_usage_sampled) to the contract and docs; emit them from the dashboard server through a new helper module src/lib/telemetry/anywhere.ts that wraps AnalyticsService (same opt-out and anonymity); dedupe supervisor channel outcomes per link; sample relay bytes hourly as a bucket; keep the overdeck.ai Workers silent and document why. The phone app's PostHog moves to sibling PAN-5021 (blocked by PAN-4841).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No PostHog, opt-out switch or store/privacy changes in the phone app (apps/mobile): sibling PAN-5021 owns them
- No telemetry from the overdeck.ai Workers (services/account, services/connect, services/share); no file under services/ changes
- No Session Vault or Shared Sessions events (pan vault sends no telemetry by PAN-2609 P-12)
- No new telemetry switch or config key; the existing opt-out governs the new events
- No change to packages/anywhere-channel (relay plan and cap refusals stay reported as unreachable)
- No events from openLinkSocket per-request opens or probeBetter failures
- No machine label, environment id, token id, URL, key, client id or raw byte count in any event property
- No change to the overdeck-landing repo or to App Store / Play Console declarations

autoDecisions.summary: Split the phone app into sibling issue PAN-5021, blocked by PAN-4841; this issue keeps desktop events and the Workers decision
autoDecisions.rationale: The phone store/privacy files exist only on the unmerged feature/pan-4841 branch, the landing copy and console answers are outside this repo, and the desktop slice alone fills the finalize lint's 6-subsystem budget.

autoDecisions.summary: The overdeck.ai Workers stay silent and the decision is documented in docs/TELEMETRY.md
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest acceptable option: client-side events already measure the funnel, and the Workers hold GitHub and device ids, so any event from them would sit next to an identity that configuration/telemetry.mdx promises never to send.

autoDecisions.summary: Supervisor channel outcomes are reported only when a link's (route, ok, error_class) tuple changes
autoDecisions.rationale: connect() retries indefinitely while a peer is offline; per-probe events would flood PostHog.

autoDecisions.summary: Relay usage is a bucketed sample at most once per hour
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the hourly github_quota_sample cadence; the 60 s directory report cadence is too frequent for telemetry.

autoDecisions.summary: The approver side of a pairing-channel exchange always reports method pairing_code
autoDecisions.rationale: The approver cannot distinguish pasted pairing URLs from SSH or Fly provisioning; all present an odp_ code.

autoDecisions.summary: Only successful phone pairings are reported from the machine
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scope names 'phone paired/removed'; pairing failures are visible on the phone and belong to PAN-5021.

items.title: Add the seven Anywhere events and domains to the telemetry contract, its docs tables and the schema test

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Append machine_link_started, machine_link_approved, machine_link_failed, phone_paired, phone_removed, anywhere_channel_opened, relay_usage_sampled to TELEMETRY_EVENT_NAMES; add domains channel_error_class, channel_route (TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_ROUTES = ROUTE_KINDS + 'stored', checked with `satisfies` against `typeof ROUTE_KINDS` via a type-only import from ./machines), link_failure_reason, link_method, link_side, phone_removed_by, relay_bytes_bucket with the exact values in the PRD; add the catalog entries, the per-event property aliases, the domain value types and bucketRelayBytes (decimal MB). In the same commit append the seven event rows and seven domain rows to docs/TELEMETRY.md in the exact table formats the PRD gives, and extend EXPECTED_EVENTS plus rename the test to 'exports all twenty-five telemetry event names'. The three files must land together: the drift tests fail otherwise. Also add to telemetry-schema.test.ts a bucketRelayBytes boundary test and a test that every ROUTE_KINDS value is in the channel_route domain (PRD WI-1 step 8).

items.title: Given the updated contract, when `npx vitest run tests/unit/contracts/telemetry-schema.test.ts` runs, then it passes with TELEMETRY_EVENT_NAMES equal to the 25-name EXPECTED_EVENTS list ending in relay_usage_sampled
Given docs/TELEMETRY.md, when `npx vitest run tests/unit/telemetry-docs.test.ts` runs, then it passes and the documented catalog equals TELEMETRY_EVENT_CATALOG including the seven new events

Given telemetry-schema.test.ts, when `npx vitest run tests/unit/contracts/telemetry-schema.test.ts` runs, then its bucket test exits 0 asserting bucketRelayBytes returns under_1mb for 999_999, 1mb-9mb for 1_000_000, 100mb-999mb for 999_999_999 and 1gb+ for 1_000_000_000
Given telemetry-schema.test.ts, when it runs, then it asserts every ROUTE_KINDS value plus `stored` is in TELEMETRY_PROPERTY_DOMAINS.channel_route, and `npm run typecheck` exits 0
Create the Anywhere telemetry helper module src/lib/telemetry/anywhere.ts with its unit test

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Export AnywhereAnalytics, defaultAnywhereAnalytics(), captureLinkStarted/Approved/Failed, capturePhonePaired, capturePhoneRemoved, captureChannelOpen (each with an `analytics = defaultAnywhereAnalytics()` default parameter and a try/catch safeCapture), linkMethodForTransport (undefined→pairing_code, ssh→ssh, public→fly, else other), linkFailureReason (structural `code` string table, else other; no import from src/dashboard), RELAY_USAGE_TELEMETRY_INTERVAL_MS = 3_600_000, class RelayUsageSampler with injectable now/analytics, and the singleton relayUsageSampler. Tests use a fake `{ capture: vi.fn() }` and an injected clock; no real waiting, no source reading.

items.title: Given a fake analytics client, when each capture function is called, then capture receives exactly the event name and closed-enum properties listed in the PRD and nothing else
Given an analytics client whose capture throws, when any helper is called, then the helper returns without throwing
linkMethodForTransport returns pairing_code, ssh, fly and other for undefined, 'ssh', 'public' and 'lan'; linkFailureReason returns other for new Error('x') and null

Given an injected clock, when the sampler records 5_000_000 bytes at t=0 and 1 byte at t=59 min, then nothing is captured, and when it records 1 byte at t=60 min, then exactly one relay_usage_sampled { bytes: '1mb-9mb' } is captured

In handleMachinesExchange call captureLinkFailed('pairing_code','approver','grant_refused') in the GrantMachineLinkError branch before the 400, and captureLinkApproved('pairing_code','approver') after `const { token, record, reverseLinkId } = granted;`. Emit two-screen approval link events from DirectoryApprovalService

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Add `analytics?: AnywhereAnalytics` to ApprovalServiceDeps. join: offline failure before the throw, else started before return. rejectJoin: failed(approval_refused). handleExchange: approved(requester) right after `join.granted = {...}` (once per join). runApprove: approved(approver) after approvals.delete; failed(approver, approval_failed) after `approval.state = 'failed'`. Method is always directory_approval.

items.title: Given a connected directory, when join runs, then analytics records machine_link_started {method:'directory_approval'}

Given directory.send returning false, when join runs, then it records machine_link_failed {method:'directory_approval', side:'requester', reason:'offline'} and throws DirectoryApprovalError('offline')
Given an accepted join, when handleExchange is called twice, then machine_link_approved {side:'requester'} is recorded exactly once

Given an approve run whose exchange answers 200, then machine_link_approved {side:'approver'} is recorded; given one that answers 403, then machine_link_failed {side:'approver', reason:'approval_failed'} is recorded

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7. Add optional dep reportChannelOpen (default captureChannelOpen), Entry fields lastProbePhase ('stored' initially) and lastChannelReport (null), set lastProbePhase before each phase probe in probePhased, add private reportChannel(entry, props) that skips a repeat of the last (route|ok|error_class) key, and call it from connect()'s !ok branch (only for unknown-peer, unsupported, or !entry.channel) and from adopt() failure/success points with the PRD's error_class mapping (NO_DIRECT_PATH_MESSAGE → no_relay_plan; heartbeat 401 → revoked). probeBetter failures and generation-mismatch returns report nothing. New test file reuses the harness pattern from link-supervisor-phases.test.ts with fake timers; no private-method calls.

items.title: Given a link whose lan route opens and heartbeats, when the supervisor starts, then reportChannelOpen is called once with {route:'lan', ok:true, error_class:'none'}

Given a link with no reachable route, when fake timers advance until openChannel has been called at least 10 times, then reportChannelOpen has been called exactly once, with {route:'stored', ok:false, error_class:'unreachable'}
Given only a failing direct route and relayEntitled returning false, when the supervisor probes, then it reports {route:'direct', ok:false, error_class:'no_relay_plan'}
Given a heartbeat that rejects with status 401, when the supervisor adopts the channel, then it reports error_class 'revoked' with the adopted route's kind
